correctness.rationale: Every factor of the four-run word lies in one of the four explicitly classified types. The unique central 10 forces one of two positions; two larger-change factors contain that transition. One-change 01 factors form the union of two parameter rectangles. Four explicit two-position witness families and two independent impossibility arguments exhaust the parameter order cases. Three positions always suffice. Two disjoint positive-integer parametrizations prove the generating function and the 1/2 limiting density. The packaged standard-library verifier independently checks all 4096 tuples with run lengths 1..8 and 19 generating coefficients, without replacing the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural complete four-parameter class of the core smallest-string-attractor invariant is resolved: exact size 2 versus 3, explicit optimal witnesses, two genuinely different sharp failure regimes, exact counting series, and limiting density one-half. These are structural, not finite-census, computational-time, or cosmetic consequences; they distinguish words attaining the alphabet lower bound from those requiring an extra position.
